expectation: Membrane/surface stain on dendritic cells and some macrophages: scattered or clustered stellate cells with processes, a minority of cells, in the HLA-DR-rich interfollicular or lymphoid tissue, mostly HLA-DR positive.
observed: A and B/C: diffuse yellow haze that follows the tissue, plus a few streaks and one ring-shaped cell. D: elongated bright streaks. E1: many bright, branched, cell-sized profiles clustered in the right half of the field, against a dim background. E3: most sit on or next to HLA-DR cells.
why: E1 and E3 show a distinct subset of branched, dendritic-shaped cells on HLA-DR-rich tissue, although the haze elsewhere lowers the contrast.
notes: Whole-tissue and typical fields show haze and streaks, but the HLA-DR-dense field shows a distinct population of branched dendritic-like CD11c cells largely on HLA-DR cells. Real stain with some background.
